{{Top|leg}}
A '''holo-bit generator''' was a device which allowed the user to manipulate a pre-recorded [[Hologram/Legends|holo]]-transmission and create a false transmission. Running the desired image through a bit manipulation program, it then created a complete set of images which formed a seemingly real transmission.

{{Tech-stub}}
